$comment: Declarative hook rules — the no-code companion to JS hooks. Rename to rules.json — strip the example- prefix — (or drop files into hooks/rules/*.json) to activate. `when` keys AND together; give a key an array for OR. Every matching rule fires. Matchers: event (required), schema, path (prefix), url (substring or {host,prefix,contains,regex}), from, to (any To/Cc recipient), subject (substring or {equals,contains,startsWith,regex}), mime ('image/*' globs), attachment (true = any; 'application/pdf' / ['image/*'] = attachment mime; {mime,filename} for both). Actions: link, unlink, tag, store (move/copy the document's BYTES between storage backends, with {{YYYY}}/{{MM}}/{{DD}}/{{HH}}/{{mm}}/{{ss}}/{{ext}}/{{basename}} key templating), delete, destroy, agent, notify, script, emit. `{{doc.data.subject}}`-style templates work in agent prompts, notify messages and script args.

rules.description: Photos filed under /Fotky move out of the blob store onto workspace:home as Fotky/YYYY/MM/YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jpg
File YouTube tabs under /media/youtube and tag them
Emails about the DC migration land under /projects/dc-migration
Ask an agent to assess urgent mail and ping me on my default channel

then.prompt: An email arrived from {{doc.data.from}} with subject "{{doc.data.subject}}". Assess whether it needs my attention right now and reply with one short sentence.

rules.description: Links pointing at PDFs get filed to /to-read
PDF invoices sent to the invoice aliases get filed and processed
Run a git/scripts helper for every indexed image blob
